description: Baseline real-LLM Playwright E2E benchmark for Pokédex template generating 3 websites

asi.hypothesis: Establish a baseline for the real /api/generate Pokédex 3-site workflow with mocks removed so future autoresearch iterations optimize against actual LLM latency.
asi.baseline_notes: Run made exactly 3 /api/generate POSTs; total click-to-render time was 13.13s, API wall time 12.174s, slowest API call 12.174s.
asi.browser_warnings: Two Tailwind CDN production warnings came from generated iframe HTML; not benchmark harness failures.

description: Lower Portkey max_tokens from 4096 to 3072 for generation calls

asi.hypothesis: Generated Pokédex HTML should fit comfortably below 3072 tokens; lowering max_tokens reduces reserved/actual decode budget without changing the prompt, generation count, provider order, or mocking real calls.
asi.result: Primary improved from 13130ms to 11160ms; API wall improved from 12174ms to 10088ms; exactly 3 generation API calls.
asi.quality_risk: Potential truncation on unusually long prompts/apps; no truncation detected by current E2E render gate, but future iterations should avoid lowering too aggressively without adding output-completeness checks.

description: Switch primary Cerebras model from gpt-oss-120b to qwen-3-32b

asi.hypothesis: A smaller but still capable Cerebras-hosted model (qwen-3-32b) should reduce real LLM latency for generated HTML while preserving the same prompt, generation count, provider fallback behavior, and output pathway.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 11160ms to 10332ms; API wall improved from 10088ms to 9447ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls.
asi.quality_risk: Model downgrade may affect generated app quality versus gpt-oss-120b; current E2E confirms render completion only, so future work should add non-cheating quality/completeness monitors before moving to much smaller models.

description: Shorten new-app generation prompt to concise requirements

asi.hypothesis: The old create prompt spent tokens on broad edge-case guidance, comments, and formatting details that increase input/output token work; a concise but general single-file-app prompt should reduce real LLM latency without changing the benchmark prompt, generation count, provider order, or using mocks.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 10332ms to 9562ms; API wall improved from 9447ms to 8086ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls.
asi.quality_risk: Shorter prompt may reduce code structure/comment richness and broad non-Pokedex behavior; still preserves complete HTML, responsiveness, iframe usability, framework imports, inline CSS/JS, and interactive controls.

description: Lower generation max_tokens from 3072 to 2048

asi.hypothesis: After the new-app prompt was compacted, generated single-file apps should usually fit within 2048 tokens; lowering the cap should reduce real LLM decode time while keeping the same prompt, 3 real generation calls, provider order, and no mocks.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 9562ms to 8537ms; API wall improved from 8086ms to 7606ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls.
asi.quality_risk: Output cap is now meaningfully tighter; current E2E render gate passed and browser warnings dropped to zero, but future iterations should add/monitor non-cheating output completeness signals before further aggressive token cuts.

description: Lower generation max_tokens from 2048 to 1792

asi.hypothesis: The previous 2048-token cap likely still left some unused or low-value generation budget after prompt compaction; a modest cut to 1792 could reduce real LLM decode latency while preserving complete concise single-file apps.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 8537ms to 8298ms; API wall improved from 7606ms to 7348ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls and zero browser errors.
asi.quality_risk: This is a smaller gain and the output cap is now tight; avoid large further max_tokens cuts without adding non-cheating completeness/finish-reason checks because the current E2E only validates rendered non-empty previews.

description: Try 1536 max_tokens with finish-reason truncation guard and code-size metrics

asi.hypothesis: A stricter 1536-token cap might reduce real LLM latency further if outputs still finish naturally; added finishReason/code-size monitoring to avoid silently keeping truncated generations.
asi.failure: Benchmark aborted because all three real LLM responses reported finishReason='length' at 1536 max_tokens; observed codeChars were 1690, 5610, and 4984 before trimming/display.
asi.rollback_reason: 1536 max_tokens truncates real generation output, so it is not a valid latency optimization despite likely speed gains.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep 1792 as the current safe cap or try a smaller incremental cut such as 1664 only with finishReason monitoring preserved; alternatively add finishReason/code-size metrics in a separate non-optimizing harness update first.

description: Try 1664 max_tokens with finish-reason truncation guard

asi.hypothesis: A smaller incremental cut from 1792 to 1664 might preserve complete outputs while reducing real LLM decode latency; finishReason monitoring was added so truncated outputs would not be kept as a false win.
asi.failure: All three real LLM responses reported finishReason='length' at 1664 max_tokens; codeChars were 4961, 5884, and 4655, so the apparent 6549ms latency was invalid.
asi.rollback_reason: 1664 max_tokens truncates real generated apps, making the optimization incorrect/cheaty despite lower measured response time.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not continue lowering max_tokens below 1792 without changing output requirements. Consider non-token-cap optimizations next, or add finishReason monitoring as a separate harness improvement that does not change the primary workload.

description: Prioritize Groq llama-3.2-1b-preview before Cerebras qwen fallback

asi.hypothesis: The existing Groq llama-3.2-1b-preview fallback may be materially faster than Cerebras qwen-3-32b for concise single-file HTML; trying it first should reduce real LLM API wall time while preserving the same prompt, max_tokens cap, generation count, and fallback safety.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 8298ms to 7419ms; API wall improved from 7348ms to 6466ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls and zero browser errors.
asi.quality_risk: This uses a much smaller 1B primary model, so generated-app correctness and polish may degrade even though render completion passed; keep monitoring quality before further model downgrades.

description: Try 1728 max_tokens with finish-reason truncation guard under Groq-first provider order

asi.hypothesis: With Groq-first provider order, a smaller 1728-token cap might still finish complete concise apps while improving real LLM latency; finishReason monitoring was added so any truncation would fail rather than be kept as a false win.
asi.failure: All three real LLM responses reported finishReason='length' at 1728 max_tokens; codeChars were 1883, 6037, and 5657. The apparent 6693ms metric is invalid because outputs were truncated.
asi.rollback_reason: 1728 max_tokens truncates generated apps under Groq-first, so reducing below 1792 is not a valid optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop lowering max_tokens. Validate current Groq-first 1792 cap with finishReason monitoring, or move to non-token-cap optimizations such as prompt wording, provider selection, or UI/render overhead.

description: Try stronger compact-output prompt with finish-reason truncation guard at 1792 tokens

asi.hypothesis: Adding explicit compactness constraints (avoid comments, large hard-coded datasets, repetitive boilerplate) might reduce output length/latency while a finishReason guard ensures truncated real LLM outputs are not treated as wins.
asi.failure: At max_tokens=1792 with Groq-first, one response stopped normally but two real responses still reported finishReason='length' (codeChars 6630 and 5257), so the apparent 6284ms latency is invalid.
asi.rollback_reason: The compact-output prompt did not reliably avoid truncation at the current token cap and benchmark guard changes were bundled with a failing product prompt change.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not lower token caps or rely on Groq-first 1792 without finishReason validation. Consider increasing max_tokens for Groq-first to 2048 with finishReason monitoring, or switch back to Cerebras/qwen if quality/completeness is prioritized over raw latency.

description: Try OpenRouter Gemini Flash Lite first with finish-reason guard

asi.hypothesis: OpenRouter Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite might be faster or more complete than Groq-first for concise HTML generation; running it first with finishReason monitoring should only keep the result if all three real outputs finish naturally.
asi.failure: All three real responses reported finishReason='length' at max_tokens=1792 (codeChars 1946, 6372, 5787), so the apparent 6392ms latency is invalid/truncated.
asi.rollback_reason: OpenRouter-first at the current cap does not complete the generated apps, making it an invalid optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid provider/cap combos without finishReason validation. Consider testing Groq-first with a higher cap such as 2048 and finishReason guard, or adding the guard as a permanent benchmark correctness improvement.

description: Try lower Groq-first temperature with finish-reason guard

asi.hypothesis: Lowering temperature from 0.7 to 0.2 might make Groq-first outputs more deterministic/compact and preserve or improve latency; finishReason monitoring ensures truncated real outputs are rejected.
asi.failure: All three real responses reported finishReason='length' at max_tokens=1792 with temperature=0.2; codeChars were 5823, 5588, and 6161. Apparent 6906ms latency is invalid because outputs were truncated.
asi.rollback_reason: Lower temperature did not produce complete outputs under the current Groq-first/token-cap setup, so it cannot be kept as a valid optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop trying to make Groq-first 1792 valid with small prompt/sampling tweaks. Next promising path: test Groq-first with max_tokens=2048 plus finishReason guard, or switch back to qwen-first if correctness is prioritized.

description: Try Groq-first max_tokens 2048 with finish-reason guard

asi.hypothesis: Increasing Groq-first max_tokens from 1792 to 2048 might allow outputs to finish naturally while preserving a latency win; finishReason monitoring prevents keeping truncated real LLM outputs.
asi.failure: All three real responses still reported finishReason='length' at max_tokens=2048; codeChars were 2201, 7070, and 7049. The apparent 8941ms metric is invalid/truncated and already slower than the current unguarded Groq-first best.
asi.rollback_reason: Groq-first remains incomplete even with a higher token cap, so this is not a valid optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Treat Groq-first 1792 best as quality-risky. Next try qwen-first with finishReason monitoring at 1792 or 2048 to establish a validated safe baseline, or add permanent finishReason metrics before optimizing further.

description: Use compact complete-output prompt with finish-reason guard

asi.hypothesis: Groq-first was fast but repeatedly truncated under the previous prompt; explicitly asking for compact complete apps under ~150 lines, no comments/large datasets/repetitive boilerplate, and stopping after </html> should make real outputs finish naturally while reducing tokens and latency.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 7419ms to 4930ms; API wall improved from 6466ms to 3957ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls; all three finishReason values were 'stop'.
asi.correctness_guard: Benchmark now rejects finishReason='length' so truncated outputs are not kept as latency wins.
asi.quality_risk: Compact prompt may reduce richness/large sample data versus previous generations, but preserves core domain-specific functionality, responsiveness, iframe usability, interactivity, and complete HTML.

description: Try lowering compact-prompt max_tokens from 1792 to 1536

asi.hypothesis: Now that the prompt explicitly asks for compact complete apps and the benchmark guards finishReason, lowering max_tokens from 1792 to 1536 might reduce real decode latency while still allowing all outputs to stop naturally.
asi.failure: At 1536 max_tokens, one response stopped normally but two real responses reported finishReason='length' (codeChars 5560 and 5607), so the apparent 6642ms metric is invalid/truncated.
asi.rollback_reason: 1536 is below the safe completion cap even with the compact prompt; keeping it would optimize by truncating generated apps.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep max_tokens at 1792 for compact prompt. Try non-cap improvements next, e.g. further prompt structure changes that preserve finishReason='stop', UI/render overhead, or provider variants with the finishReason guard.

description: Try lowering compact-prompt max_tokens from 1792 to 1664

asi.hypothesis: Since 1536 was too low but compact prompt outputs were much shorter, 1664 might be enough for all three real generations to stop naturally while improving latency.
asi.failure: At 1664 max_tokens, two responses stopped naturally but one real response reported finishReason='length' (codeChars 4694), making the apparent 5731ms latency invalid/truncated.
asi.rollback_reason: 1664 is still below the safe completion cap for compact prompt; keeping it would optimize by truncating at least one generated app.
asi.next_action_hint: Try a smaller cut from 1792 such as 1728 only if worthwhile, but expect narrow margin; otherwise keep 1792 and explore non-cap changes such as reducing UI wait overhead or provider/prompt variants that preserve finishReason='stop'.

description: Try compact-prompt max_tokens 1728

asi.hypothesis: After compact prompt, 1728 tokens might be sufficient and slightly faster than the current 1792 cap while still avoiding truncation via finishReason guard.
asi.result: All 3 real responses finished naturally (finishReason='stop') with codeChars 3972, 5936, 5730, but primary metric was 7978ms versus current best 4930ms.
asi.rollback_reason: The lower cap completed but was materially slower than the current best, so it is not an improvement.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not keep small cap changes unless they beat 4.93s. Try structural non-cap optimizations next, such as reducing post-API UI/render wait or further prompt wording that keeps finishReason='stop' and preserves core functionality.

description: Tighten compact prompt line budget from about 150 to about 120 lines

asi.hypothesis: A tighter but still general line budget (~120 lines instead of ~150) might reduce output length and real LLM latency while preserving complete apps, with finishReason guard rejecting truncation.
asi.failure: At the 120-line prompt, one of three real responses reported finishReason='length' and the apparent metric was 7249ms, slower than the 4930ms best. CodeChars were 5505, 6346, and 7412.
asi.rollback_reason: The tighter line-budget prompt did not reliably produce shorter complete output and caused truncation, so keeping it would risk incomplete generated apps.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not keep tightening line-count wording blindly. Try non-line-budget prompt simplification, framework/CDN prompt changes, or UI/render overhead reductions while preserving finishReason='stop'.

description: Shorten framework and variation instruction strings

asi.hypothesis: Shorter general framework prompts and variation labels should reduce input tokens and possibly output verbosity while preserving the three generated variants and real LLM calls.
asi.failure: One of three real responses reported finishReason='length' after shortening instructions; codeChars were 4631, 5852, and 6658, with apparent latency 6230ms (worse than 4930ms best).
asi.rollback_reason: The terse instructions did not improve latency and caused a truncated output, so it is not a valid optimization.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the existing compact prompt/variation wording. Consider UI-level changes or benchmarking current best for stability rather than further removing guidance.

description: Hoist Portkey client/config to module scope for reuse

asi.hypothesis: Creating a Portkey client/config for every /api/generate request may add per-call overhead; caching the configured client at module scope could reduce server-side overhead without changing prompt, model, max_tokens, or real LLM behavior.
asi.failure: Run failed the finishReason guard: two of three real responses reported finishReason='length' (codeChars 5927 and 6601), and apparent latency 6241ms was worse than current best 4930ms.
asi.rollback_reason: The optimization did not produce a valid complete generation run and did not target the dominant LLM decode bottleneck strongly enough.
asi.next_action_hint: Focus on output-shaping or provider choices that preserve finishReason='stop'; client construction overhead is likely negligible relative to real LLM generation time.
